name: Parque del Oeste bunkers
story: The northern end of the Parque del Oeste lay right on the front line facing the Nationalist salient in the University City. Nationalist sappers built concrete machine-gun posts here under fire; the stages of construction are still visible in the concrete, and one carries the inscription 'Zapadores nº 7'. Of around twenty such posts, three survive, protected as heritage. They are among the few tangible traces of the two-and-a-half-year siege line inside the city itself.
see: Three sealed concrete machine-gun bunkers among the park's trees and lawns.
plan: Free, open park; 10 minutes' walk from Metro Moncloa. Combine with the University City and Casa de Velázquez.
